items.title_en: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
items.summary: Anthropic is hiring fewer and fewer junior staff in technical roles. The share of junior positions among new hires dropped from 27 to 9 percent since early 2025. By August 2026, AI agents across the company were already logging six times as many hours as humans.

items.title_en: AI agents have bad taste in long-term decisions and a new benchmark proves it
items.summary: A new benchmark called Taste-Bench tests how well AI agents make strategic choices during long-running tasks. Even the best model, GPT-5.6 Sol, picks the right path on just under 60 percent of simple binary questions. Thinking longer doesn't help.
